intel.name: Activation message
intel.description: A dead phone. One message, six words: 'They have activated the protocol. Run.' The metadata points at a locker in Mbare bus terminus.

intel.name: Mhara's phone
intel.description: The deputy director's handset. Dumped in a drain in Chitungwiza. One unsent message, one photograph of Tinashe, one account number: MSG-09.

intel.name: Lovemore's statement
intel.description: A porter saw who emptied the locker: a man with a Meridian badge that did not scan. He remembers the car's plate and the silence after.

intel.name: MSG-09
intel.description: A shell account routed through Meridian Strategic Group's Harare office. Identical payments from three ministries over four years.

intel.name: Cleaner roster
intel.description: A Meridian internal duty sheet. Two names circled: Sable is a callsign, not a person. The other is Victor Nhari. Officially dead.

intel.name: Tafadzwa's tip
intel.description: A tip about a meeting at the Avondale safehouse. The timing is exact. The source is compromised. Someone knows where Tinashe sleeps.

intel.name: Safehouse leak
intel.description: The precise layout of Tinashe's flat is on a Meridian planning sheet. The fence, the garage, the dog that does not bark.

intel.name: Ledger page
intel.description: One page of the Black Ledger: a list of threats with disposal dates. The first name on the list is Tinashe Mukasa.

witnesses.name: Lovemore Chigumba
witnesses.description: Witnessed the locker kill. If sparing him wiser than killing him, the Shadow Network will wish he had gone with the others.

witnesses.name: Tafadzwa Dube
witnesses.description: Pulled the tip about the Avondale safehouse. Did not know the source was Meridian. Is not sure he wants to know.

epilogues.title: SEASON ONE CONTINUES
epilogues.text: Avondale burns behind you. Tafadzwa is in a bed in Mbare, alive because you carried him or because Amara was faster. Emmanuel Mhara is still missing. Victor Nhari is still walking the city. Somewhere in the dark, a file opens on a desk that does not exist: SUBJECT: TINASHE MUKASA — STATUS: ACTIVE THREAT. The Black Ledger is not found yet. The Lockout is not yet a blackout. Episode 04 — BROKEN TRUST — begins soon. But nobody sends word to run. They do not have to anymore.
